lines.text: Paul and other prisoners are handed to a centurion named Julius and board an Adramyttian ship with Aristarchus.
They land at Tyre, sail to the lee of Cyprus, and at Myra board a ship bound for Italy.
Paul warns of disaster, but the centurion follows the pilot and the owner, and most decide to sail on.
A gentle south wind blows, then the Northeaster cyclone hits, and they pass Cauda and lower the sea anchor.
An angel tells Paul he must preach in Jerusalem, and God has granted him the lives of all aboard.
